desc: This move seeks to punish White's press move at <A:Q15>, because the pincer stone would be further from White's thickness, making counterplay less effective. But this pincer leaves White room to make an ideal base at <B:M17>, giving White stability in the area. See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 53, Huang Yunsong 5p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-nW02Duktd4&t=171s).
